messages:
emily-partnerships: Heads up — NebulaCloud just flagged a partial shipment. We expected 40 racks for the marketplace launch but the carrier split into two manifests. Need allocation decision before Tues announcement. Manifest summary: SKU NVX-80x, qty 30 arriving 2026-03-30 -> us-west; qty 10 delayed to 2026-04-12 -> eu-central.

raj-sales: Can we scope the announcement to NA first? Push EU to 'coming soon' so we don't promise capacity we might not have. Partner says they need a firm commit or they'll incur rescheduling fees.

lucas-ops: Quick ops read: our Dedicated pool currently pins 24 NVX-80x for reserved customers. If we allocate 6 to marketplace burst in us-west, reserved SLOs remain fine. If EU racks don't arrive, marketplace overall throughput drops ~25%.

anna-logistics: Carrier split due to customs quota at the port. We can request an airlift for the 10 delayed units but cost is ~USD45,000 + expedited customs brokerage. Airlift ETA would be ~2026-04-03 if approved today.

kathy-legal: Flagging contract language — joint announcement currently states "available in NA & EU". Until eu units are in-hand, we should not claim EU availability. Recommend redline to "EU availability expected in April" + contingency language.

emily-partnerships: @sam-engineering do we have a technical mitigation if EU hardware is delayed? Could we run marketplace workloads for EU customers temporarily on cloud-hosted instances to preserve the announcement timeline?

sam-engineering: Yes — we can spin up cloud-hosted NVX equivalents and route marketplace EU traffic there for the first 2 weeks. Need a feature flag and cost approval. Config change is small: `kubectl apply -f canary-config.yaml` to enable cloud fallback and `route-policy: marketplace-eu -> cloud-fallback` in our routing table.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `marketplace-v1` canary at 22:00 UTC pending capacity confirmation.

raj-sales: Budget check: airlift (~45k) vs cloud fallback (estimated ~60k for 2 weeks including egress). Anna, can you post a quick cost breakout so we can pick? I'd prefer not to delay announcement if partner is ready.

anna-logistics: Uploaded cost sheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/marketplace-shipping. TL;DR: airlift+brokerage = 45k, cloud fallback 2 weeks = ~60k (includes hourly instances + egress + on-call ops). Airlift risk = customs hold; cloud fallback risk = higher cost and possible perf delta.

emily-partnerships: Decision for now: proceed with NA-first announcement copy, update release notes to "EU rolling availability subject to shipping & customs". Sam, proceed with cloud fallback plan and only enable canary for NA. @kathy please redline the partner joint announcement copy to remove guaranteed EU availability.

kathy-legal: On it. I'll remove direct EU availability language and add: "EU availability expected April; subject to shipping and customs clearance." Also adding contingency language re: timing.

lucas-ops: I'll reserve 6 NVX-80x in us-west for marketplace burst and add an autoscaler guard to avoid impacting reserved pools. Canary ramp plan: 10% -> 30% over 3 hours. I'll post the autoscaler snippet in the ops doc.

raj-sales: :thumbsup: Thanks team. Emily, want me to tell NebulaCloud on tomorrow's call (0900 PT) the plan and confirm whether they want to pay for airlift?

emily-partnerships: Yes please — schedule sync 0900 PT. Agenda: confirm allocation, airlift approval cutoff, announcement wording, and the canary/capacity fallback plan. I will send invite and share the redline with the partner.

sam-engineering: I'll prepare the feature flag PR and a short rollback playbook. PR will include the `route-policy` change and the `canary-config.yaml` snippet.

emily-partnerships: Great — thanks everyone. I'll update the marketplace checklist and mark "EU availability" as conditional until we get firm delivery confirmation.
